status.title: Status
status.x-seam-help: A plain static select: four options, so no search box.

discipline.title: Discipline
discipline.x-seam-help: Ten options: from eight up, the select turns into a combobox with a live search box.

failure_mode.title: Failure mode
failure_mode.x-seam-help: x-seam-option-groups: options are grouped under a heading taken from the text before the first underscore (mechanical, electrical, process).

severity.title: Severity
severity.x-seam-help: x-seam-option-icons with x-seam-icon-position: right. Pick High or Critical to reveal Escalation contact below.

escalation_contact.title: Escalation contact
escalation_contact.x-seam-help: x-seam-visible-when with op in: shown only while Severity is High or Critical.

shutdown_reason.title: Shutdown reason
shutdown_reason.x-seam-help: Pick Other to reveal the two fields below.

shutdown_notes.title: Shutdown notes
shutdown_notes.x-seam-help: Visible while Shutdown reason is Other.

shutdown_hours.title: Estimated downtime
shutdown_hours.x-seam-help: A composite rule (all_of): Shutdown reason is Other and Severity has a value.

brand_id.title: Brand
brand_id.x-seam-help: A foreign-key select: options come from the tenant's brands (x-seam-source). Once a brand is chosen, the preview button next to the field opens a floating summary card (x-seam-fk-popover).

skills.title: Skills required
skills.x-seam-help: A checkbox group; each ticked option is posted under skills[].

linked_asset_id.title: Linked asset
linked_asset_id.x-seam-help: asset-picker: the first assets are listed as soon as the box gets focus, and the list narrows as you type; the field posts the numeric id and shows the name.

marked_asset_id.title: Linked asset (marker highlight)
marked_asset_id.x-seam-help: The same widget with x-seam-highlight: background, a marker-style match instead of bold text.

reviewer_id.title: Reviewer
reviewer_id.x-seam-help: any-picker with a Browse button (the Selectors tab shows it over more entities).

icon.title: Icon
icon.x-seam-help: Search the Material Icons by name; the glyph is previewed beside the box and the name is what gets posted.
